- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed types of biodegradable packaging materials, including PLA (Polylactic Acid), PBAT (Polybutylene Adipate-co-Butylene Terephthalate), PHA (Polyhydroxyalkanoates), cellulose, and molded fiber.
